newsitem.title: USA: Express Scripts unit launches database.
newsitem.headline: Express Scripts unit launches database.

text.p: Practice Patterns Science Inc, a unit of Express Scripts Inc, said Friday it has developed a national comparative database as a resource tool for the pharmaceutical and health care industries.

The database, called PTE-Registry, can be used to identify reductions in medical treatment charges, side effects outlined in medical claims data and treatment duration for acute illnesses, the company said.
Practice Patterns Science is a health care information services company.
Express Scripts administers prescription drug programs.
Its shares were trading down 1/8 Friday at 33-3/8.
